title: My Neighborhood
text:
My neighborhood is small and quiet. There is a park near my house. Many children play there after school.

There is also a small shop on the corner. The shop owner is very friendly. I buy bread there every morning.

questions.text: What does the writer buy at the shop?
How does the writer probably feel about the neighborhood?
Why do the children probably go to the park after school?
options: because they like to play there

vocabulary.definition: a public area with grass and trees where people can relax or play
kind and easy to talk to
the place where two streets meet

paragraph_translations: Meu bairro é pequeno e tranquilo. Há um parque perto da minha casa. Muitas crianças brincam lá depois da escola.
Também há uma pequena loja na esquina. O dono da loja é muito simpático. Eu compro pão lá todas as manhãs.
